Markus / Elena — I completed an initial pass on the MSA and attached a PDF summary (redline_comments.pdf) with inline callouts. High-level flags: 

1) Data processing + retention (Section 6): Clearwater's redline asking for retention beyond 24 months is possible but we need to clarify the dataset scope. Recommend: add a narrow data residency exhibit and preserve standard deletion windows; propose a maximum retention window in Exhibit B.
2) Indemnity & Limitation of Liability (Sections 11–12): Clearwater proposes removing our aggregated liability cap. We should hold to the standard cap but can discuss carve-outs tied to security breach indemnity.
3) SLA / Credits: Order form needs the exact concurrency / qps numbers if you want a custom SLA. Without clear utilization numbers we can't commit to a modified SLA.
4) Security questionnaire: ask for Clearwater's SOC 2 cert or allow us to share our attestation; also confirm whether an external audit report will be accepted.

Attachments: redline_comments.pdf (contains tracked excerpts and suggested language).

Proposed timeline: I can produce tracked changes to the Word doc by EOD tomorrow (Tue 24 Aug) if we have the legal entity name + billing contact by noon PT today. If the entity name isn't provided, I'll still return comments but cannot finalize the signature block.

Markus / Lauren — I'll draft tracked changes and a short summary memo for the commercial team. Priyom, please flag any billing config constraints once Markus has the order form details.

— Naomi Feldman
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
